@everyone 📢 TOMORROW'S LIVESTREAM EVENT – TEAM DEATHMATCH 🔥

Everyone, tomorrow during the livestream, we'll be setting up a special Team Deathmatch map!

📍 Map: Between Club and Gas'n Go.

🚔 Police Team: Police vehicles, police tape, and crime scene decorations outside Club.

🚨 Criminal Team: A pickup truck at Gas'n Go, surrounded by wrecked vehicles to create a dramatic scene.

🎮 When I say START, both teams will begin fighting against each other.

⚠️ RULES:

- No driving vehicles.
- Wait for the START command.
- Stay with your team.

🔥 Get ready! See you tomorrow on the livestream!

👑 ZET IS THE BEST FAMILY!
